report:
Reviewed the complete meta.anchors.test_references claim, both ordinary implementation associations and all five ordinary tests. Independently verified exact historical/current byte equality for correspondence.rs and spec.rs implementation files and correspondence.rs tests; the sole spec.rs test-file delta changes unrelated review-inventory claim access to the fragment schema. The associated test and its setup remain unchanged. This supports the prior source assessment, which I reassessed against current captured claim, implementation behavior, metadata and assertions.

correspondence::record_tests parses each sage::test reference, requires a free module-level built-in #[test] function, rejects nested functions/methods and non-test placements, requires Cargo test and standard harness eligibility, and rejects direct or recursively conditional ignore attributes. Cargo loading and module traversal preserve unit/integration/out-of-line test sites. Each attribute appends a site without a crate-ownership restriction, allowing many-to-many and cross-crate links. spec::validate_test_references checks every referenced key against existing anchors and reports dangling references at their annotation spans.

cargo_discovers_unit_and_integration_tests_and_excludes_disabled_harnesses asserts exactly three valid unit/integration/support entries with expected target/file identities and two disabled-target diagnostics. ignored_tests_cannot_supply_specification_coverage checks empty coverage plus an ignored diagnostic for bare/reasoned ignore and single/nested cfg_attr ignore. test_annotations_reject_malformed_names_and_unsupported_placements checks each malformed name and non-test/type/module/method/nested-function/nested-module/non-built-in-test placement produces no coverage and the appropriate diagnostic. tests_from_different_crates_can_reference_the_same_specification_rule checks two distinct crate sites and successful specification validation. test_coverage_is_bidirectional_and_allows_many_to_many_links checks multiple sites per anchor and shared test identity across anchors succeed, then checks missing coverage and a dangling anchor yield exactly two diagnostics with the dangling annotation span and name. These assertions would detect accepting ineligible references, rejecting permitted cross-crate links, or failing to diagnose dangling references. Captured the index, source, and test_site setup helpers with review read. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist.

This is source adequacy review and historical byte comparison. I executed review start/read and comparison commands, and personally record this report; I did not execute behavioral tests or a workspace build. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; those are not reviewer-executed results. No edits requested.
